aboutEvent.heading: ONE DAY. ONE COMMUNITY. MORE WAYS TO GROW.
paragraphs: AWS Student Community Day 2026 is organized by the AWS Student Builder Group at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET). It is crafted for student developers, aspiring cloud practitioners, and tech enthusiasts looking to build practical cloud skills.
From serverless architectures and containerization to generative AI workflows and full-stack cloud applications, this conference bridges the gap between academic theory and real-world engineering.
Experience technical masterclasses, live peer coding challenges, industry keynote interactions, and network with high-energy developers from across Delhi NCR.

faqs.question: What is AWS Student Community Day 2026?
faqs.answer: It is an in-person, community-organized technical conference hosted by the AWS Student Builder Group at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET). It brings together students, faculty, and cloud engineers for a full day of hands-on learning, workshops, and networking.

faqs.question: Is registration free of charge?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration and participation are completely free. However, seats are limited to venue capacity, so pre-registration is required.

faqs.question: Who can attend this event?
faqs.answer: The event is open to all university and college students (all branches and years of study), recent graduates, and tech enthusiasts interested in software engineering, cloud computing, and AI.

faqs.question: How will I receive my entry pass?
faqs.answer: Upon completing the online registration form, you will immediately receive your unique Digital QR Entry Pass on the confirmation screen, which you can save and bookmark.

faqs.question: What do I need to bring on event day?
faqs.answer: Please bring a valid college/student physical photo ID card along with your digital QR pass on your mobile device. If you plan to follow along with the hands-on lab, bringing a laptop is recommended.

faqs.question: Where is the event venue located?
faqs.answer: The event takes place at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), 1, Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306. The venue is easily accessible via the Knowledge Park II Metro Station (Aqua Line).
